none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

results.references:
- Angelia Nedić and Soomin Lee. [On Stochastic Subgradient Mirror-Descent Algorithm with Weighted Averaging](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1307.1879v1). 2014; consulted 2013 preprint v1. Complexity: $O(1+D^2(C^2+
u^2)/\varepsilon^2)$ fixed stochastic subgradient calls for expected objective gap $\le\varepsilon$, using Euclidean mirror descent with weighted averaging. Here $D$ is the feasible-set diameter, $C$ bounds mean subgradients, and $
u^2$ bounds conditional error second moments; on $[\mathrm{lower},\mathrm{upper}]\cap[x_0-R,x_0+R]$, $D\le2R$ and $C,
u\le H$.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize a convex, H-Lipschitz function on the nonempty closed interval [lower, upper] in ℝ. A minimizer xstar exists with |x0−xstar|≤R. No differentiability or strong convexity is required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A stochastic subgradient oracle returns a scalar G_n at an adapted feasible query x_n. Almost surely |G_n|≤H, and E[G_n | past_n] supports f throughout the feasible interval. Function values and exact subgradients are not supplied.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: The almost-sure reply bound implies E[G_n² | past_n]≤H² and E[(G_n−E[G_n | past_n])² | past_n]≤H².

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The decision space is one-dimensional Euclidean space ℝ, with absolute-value distance.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The joint seed law may have arbitrary temporal dependence; neither independence nor mixing is assumed. Conditional subgradient validity is required for every past-measurable feasible query. All parameters lower, upper, H>0, R≥0, ε>0, and feasible x0 are public; f and the oracle law are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/BoundedScalarConvex.lean: past, IsBoundedSubgradientOracle, Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.valid; LongTails/Template.lean: Oracle.law.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output has an integrable objective gap f(output)−f(xstar), whose expectation is at most ε for an interval minimizer xstar.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The output must be measurable and belong to [lower, upper] for every realization.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The guarantee averages over algorithm randomness and the joint oracle seed law. Oracle cost is bounded by the fixed extracted budget max(1, ceil(25H²R²/ε²)) on every execution.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/BoundedScalarConvex.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and execute; supplied result budget.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Constrained Lipschitz convex minimization with bounded stochastic subgradient replies, conditional subgradient validity, and expected objective-gap accuracy is a standard stochastic approximation formulation.
